scope: Modifier records of one user-owned commercial FW13 tonepack as serialised by the FM3 (counts only; tools/fm3/tonepack-structure-evidence.mjs).

removalForm.meaning: source, target effect ID and target PID set to 0
removalForm.keptWords: all other words (Min/Max, curve, times, channel, words 21-24)

findings: All 652 initialised but inactive records (source 0) also have target effect 0 and PID 0, and keep their other words (50 keep a non-default Min/Max): this is the form a removed binding leaves.
265 of them sit between active records: the FM3 does not move later bindings down when one is removed.
The 10012 other inactive records are unused (words 0-20 zero, 21/22 = 65534).
use: scripts/fm3-modifier-removal.mjs writes this form for one record (codec only; no generator field uses it yet because every generated preset starts from a base without that binding).
notProven: device import of a file where a binding was removed this way
FM3-Edit behaviour when such a record is reused
